description:
Use this when the user asks what an Indian company has said in its filings about a topic, what changed at it, or whether it states an exposure to a factor. Answers are the company's own words with dates, never a view.

Returns what the company's own filings state, as statements grouped into sections, each with the sentence it rests on, a link to the filing, the period it covers, the dates it was first seen and last confirmed, and how many filings state it. `section` limits the result to one of: business_segments, results_metrics, exposures, projects_capacity, deals_partners, orders, guidance_outlook, risks_disputes, people_governance, money_capital, demand_pricing, regulation_policy, group_structure, management_stressed, other. `since` (YYYY-MM-DD) keeps statements last confirmed on or after that date; `limit` is 1 to 100 (default 40); `include_history=true` adds superseded statements and results older than eight quarters.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
